needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous and usable footpath along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian route.
Remove all obstructions from the footway on the right side to eliminate trip hazards and ensure safe pedestrian passage.
Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing at this busy intersection to provide a safer crossing point for pedestrians.
If a crossing is installed, include a proper pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe area for pedestrians to wait before crossing.
If a crossing is installed, add dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Upgrade existing street lighting to ensure better visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
